comparisons.reason: Both read OC_comments with any-comment binary outputs and the same 0/null rules, but the constructs differ. Left requires a specific institutional precedent (existing law, policy, court, organization or system) presented as functioning in practice. Right accepts any concrete, checkable specific case, including a person, event, place or personal/local situation, and does not require an institution or that it function. Right is much broader. Left excludes proposed-only or non-functioning institutions. A personal anecdote would count for right but not for left.
